method: Internal Go implementation review and reproduced regression; not external review

findings.title: Admission-buffer increase can strand already accepted winning claims
findings.precondition: Authorized policy update increases LPBuffer beyond physical LP headroom after accepted open and recognized obligations
findings.before_fix_result: Policy update accepted; winner settlement rejected: post-settlement capital buffer insufficient
findings.fix: For the opt-in funded capital rule, reject a buffer increase exceeding LPAvailable minus total current exposure, before committing the policy update.
findings.regression: Reject one atomic unit above the safe boundary; accept the exact boundary; settle and pay existing claims while betting is paused; reject new risk without buffer headroom.

limits: Legacy policies omitting Capital retain historical behavior; this is not a claim that every historical deployment is repaired.
Independent contract/pricing reviews, calibrated risk limits and deployed permissions remain unverified.
Existing LP capital-moving contracts, daily lot ownership and free withdrawals still require reconciliation.
